description: Harbour Approach routes and Communication infrastructure is a dataset listed in Malta Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Planning Authority. This dataset consists of part of the Strategic Proposals and Marine Objectives as published in the Strategic Plan for the Environment and Development (SPED). It shows the Harbour Approach routes and communication infrastructure. Coverage: Planning Authority. The publisher named on the listing is Planning Authority. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2026-02-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-mt.
